title: Heuristic Curator for Cache & Batching Recommendations
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact, explainable recommendation surface for Redwood Console that suggests cache and batching settings (e.g., max_batch_size, prefix-KV cache TTL, batch_timeout_ms) tailored to a route's traffic profile. The component should show a confidence score, expected cost delta, and a short rationale so engineers can safely accept, tweak, simulate, and rollout changes with guardrails and quick rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Visual design for a 'Heuristic Curator' panel with sections: Recommendation summary, Rationale (2-3 bullet explainers), Simulated impact (latency/cost), and Safeguard toggles
Prototype allows a PM/engineer to toggle between conservative/optimistic presets and run a local simulation showing token-level cost and median latency delta
Recommendation card exposes a clear CTA to apply to a route and auto-populates the rollout wizard with canary split and rollback thresholds
Explainability copy includes the top 2 signals used (traffic shape, median seq length, cold KV hit-rate) and the confidence band as a percentage
Design accommodates 'why not' modal for blocked recommendations and presents alternative lower-risk suggestions
Handoff assets (Figma frames + spec) uploaded and linked, with developer notes for edge cases (heterogeneous workloads, low-volume routes)

2025-03-03 - Security (Noah Reed): Confirmed no sensitive data surfaced by simulator; suggested adding audit log entry when recommendations are accepted.
2025-03-05 - Design critique (Team): Tighten copy for rationale to 2 sentences and replace percentage confidence with quartile bands for readability. Resolved in figma v3.

2025-03-01 - Eng (Marco Nguyen): Built a small simulator script in ENG-4201 that takes traffic histogram CSV and outputs expected median latency and monthly cost delta. Shared PR link in attachments.
2025-03-04 - PM (Lena Ortiz): Quick sync — prioritize the 'simulate' preview and rollout autopopulate for M1 launch. Minor copy edits requested.

implementation_notes: Panel should call /console/v1/suggest-batch-cache with route_id and historical traffic window; response: list of recommendations with confidence and simulated deltas
Simulator must run with budget-limited estimation; show 95th percentile latency estimate and month-over-month token cost comparison
When user accepts, UI should create a rollout config draft with canary=5%, step=24h, rollback_on_error_rate>threshold and open Rollouts wizard
edge_cases: Very low-traffic routes: recommend 'no change' or suggest a staged prefetch TTL instead of aggressive batching
Multi-model routes: surface model-specific recommendations and warn about kernel incompatibilities
Burst traffic patterns: show increased uncertainty and lower confidence band
